title: docs(desktop): record what the webcam track shipped and learned; pin hook binaries, check ADR numbers
body:
## What this is

The webcam track (NIW2-565) merged on 2026-10-31. This PR records what shipped, how it was reviewed, and the lessons, in `backlog/webcam-track.md` (same shape as #470). It also adds two checks so the most expensive mistakes fail on their own.

## Changes

- **`backlog/webcam-track.md`**:
  - status banner moved to "merged";
  - new sections: **What shipped** (PR table), **How it was built and reviewed**, **Still unverified**, the new follow-ups, and **Lessons**;
  - no backlog row: #473 removed the hand-kept index, so the page carries its own status.
- **`lefthook.yml`**: pre-commit calls `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt` and `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint` instead of `bunx`.
  - Why: in a worktree without `node_modules`, `bunx` downloaded a different formatter version and reformatted five files of `main` inside a merge commit.
  - Now the hook fails loudly when the tools are missing.
- **`scripts/check-adr-numbers.ts`**: runs first in `verify:local` (pre-push). It fails in two cases:
  - two ADR files share a number;
  - a branch's ADR number is already taken on `origin/main` by a different decision.
  - Why: the webcam stack held 0032/0033 in about 120 citations across twelve branches while `main` gave those numbers to workspaces, and renumbering took two cascade rounds.

No Linear ticket: the workspace hit its free issue limit.

## How to test it yourself

1. Read `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/backlog/webcam-track.md`, from "What shipped" to "Lessons". Check that it matches what you saw in QA.
2. ADR check, failing case: `touch apps/documentation/src/content/docs/architecture/decisions/0032-test.mdx && bun scripts/check-adr-numbers.ts`. It exits 1 and says 0032 is taken on `origin/main` by the workspaces ADR. Then `rm` the file.
3. ADR check, passing case: `bun scripts/check-adr-numbers.ts` on this branch exits 0 with no output.
4. Hook: in a fresh worktree without `bun install`, `git commit` now fails with "./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt: No such file or directory" instead of formatting with a downloaded version.
